# datadog_rum_retention_quota (Resource)

Provides a Datadog RumRetentionQuota resource. This can be used to create and manage Datadog rum_retention_quota.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create new rum_retention_quota resource

resource "datadog_rum_retention_quota" "testing_rum_retention_quota" {
  application_id = "<APPLICATION_ID>"
  mode           = "custom"
  custom {
    window_type          = "daily"
    session_limit        = 10000
    daily_reset_time     = "00:00"
    daily_reset_timezone = "+00:00"
    quota_reached_action = "stop"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) RUM application ID.
- `mode` (String) The retention quota mode. Valid values are `custom`.

### Optional

- `custom` (Block, Optional) Custom retention quota configuration. Required when `mode` is `custom`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--custom))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--custom"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom`

Required:

- `daily_reset_time` (String) The time of day the quota resets, in `HH:MM` format.
- `daily_reset_timezone` (String) The UTC offset for `daily_reset_time`, in `±HH:MM` format.
- `quota_reached_action` (String) The action taken once the quota is reached. Valid values are `stop`, `slowdown`.
- `session_limit` (Number) The maximum number of sessions to retain within the window.
- `window_type` (String) The window over which the quota resets. Valid values are `daily`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import datadog_rum_retention_quota.testing_rum_retention_quota "<application_id>"
```
